GPTR-F-002-S71.title: Token Revocation Logic
GPTR-F-002-S71.description: Implement explicit token revocation capability by setting revoked_at and ensuring revoked tokens are immediately invalidated across all authentication flows. Support revocation by token_id and by actor scope.
GPTR-F-002-S71.evidence: Code/DataPipelines/auth.py; Code/DataPipelines/gpt_reader.py; GAP: No revocation mechanism currently implemented

GPTR-F-002-S72.title: Token Management API Endpoints
GPTR-F-002-S72.description: Expose internal API endpoints for token lifecycle operations including rotate, revoke, and inspect token status. Ensure endpoints are protected and aligned with existing Azure Function patterns.
GPTR-F-002-S72.evidence: Code/DataPipelines/function_app.py; Code/DataPipelines/auth.py; GAP: No lifecycle management endpoints exist

GPTR-F-002-S73.title: Token Audit Logging and Traceability
GPTR-F-002-S73.description: Extend existing audit logging to capture token lifecycle events including issuance, rotation, revocation, and expiration failures. Ensure logs include actor metadata and are compatible with existing debug_logger and audit patterns.

GPTR-F-002-S74.title: Token Lifecycle Test Suite (Unit + Integration)
